title: Fibre Connectivity in the UK data set
findings: Ofcom states it holds premise-level full-fibre coverage from individual providers collected for Connected Nations reports.
Ofcom states it may show available networks at a particular address on its broadband coverage checker.
Ofcom states it does not have permission to release that provider-level data in bulk form.
Ofcom cites FOI Act section 44(1)(a) and Communications Act 2003 section 393(1) as the legal basis for withholding the bulk provider-level data.
scope_caveat: This FOI concerns provider-identifiable premise/address-level checker data. It does not establish that the separate public Spring 2026 corrected-r2 aggregate coverage archive is exempt or unavailable, so it does not satisfy the archive-acquisition criterion.
